figurative_meaning_en: Power to cause harm or mischief; cause of arrogance
similar_in_english: Draw one's fangs (to disarm or neutralize a threat)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তোমার বিষদাঁত ভেঙে দেবো, আর কোনো ক্ষতি করতে পারবে না।
ঝড়ের বিষদাঁত ভেঙে গেছে, এখন শান্তি ফিরে এসেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: I'll break your venomous fangs; you won't be able to harm anyone anymore.
The storm's fangs have been broken; peace has returned now.
note: Often used metaphorically to describe neutralizing a dangerous or arrogant entity, drawing from imagery of snakes or wild animals in Bengali folklore.
